Chloe / Marissa / Sara —

Attached: q2_token_export_20270509.csv (export of token usage by route + month) and roi_summary_odyssey_v2.pdf (2-page snapshot). Short summary below.

Summary highlights:
- Committed tokens (current annualized): 60M tokens
- Q1–Q2 actualized: 28.4M tokens (projected 12-month run-rate ~57M if growth continues at 8% qtr-over-qtr)
- Burst events (pilot triage): accounted for ~4.8M tokens in Feb–Mar; these were ~85% rerank/generation traffic with long sequences (avg seq len 520)

Recommendations (commercial and operational):
1) Commit guidance: 65M tokens for 12 months gives ~14% buffer vs projected run-rate and reduces overage risk under 10% probability (Monte Carlo stress test attached in PDF).
2) Term + rollover: Offer a 12-month commitment with a 20% unused-token rollover allowance at renewal. Rollover applies only to base committed tokens, not to burst overages.
3) Discounting: For 12-month commit at 65M, propose a 12% MSRP discount applied to base rate plus a 5% renewal credit on actualized usage if spend > 90% of commit (incentivizes utilization).
4) Operational levers: Recommend enabling prefix caching for high-reuse routes and changing generation max tokens on triage route to reduce per-token cost (could shave 6–9% token consumption).

Next steps: Chloe to convert into a short proposal; Marissa to confirm discount cadence for renewal documents. Sara — if the 20% rollover and combined 12% discount + 5% credit looks reasonable, we can draft an amendment + DocuSign for the base commit and leave burst overages as pay-as-you-go.
